title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of every skills/*/*/SKILL.md in this repo. Follows the Agent Skills spec (https://agentskills.io/specification).

name.description: Kebab-case, must match the skill's directory name, unique across the whole repo.

description.description: Third person, starts with 'Use when...'. Describes ONLY when to use the skill (triggers, symptoms, keywords) — never a summary of its workflow.
